parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The ID of the GA instance.

parameters.name: AccessLogSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the access logging feature is enabled. Default value: off. Valid values:

*   **on**: The access logging feature is enabled.
*   **off**: The access logging feature is disabled.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupType
parameters.description:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values: Valid values:

*   **default**
*   **virtual**
*   If you leave this parameter empty, all default and virtual endpoint groups are queried.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of the endpoint group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-endpoint-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --endpoint-group-type virtual --access-log-switch on --endpoint-group-id epg-bp16jdc00bhe97sr50000 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --endpoint-group-region example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga ListEndpointGroups --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'test-key' --EndpointGroupRegion 'example-string' --EndpointGroupId 'epg-bp16jdc00bhe97sr50000' --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value 'test-value' --AccessLogSwitch on --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AcceleratorId 'ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000' --EndpointGroupType virtual --ListenerId 'lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000'
